snippet.title: Draconus: Cult of the Wyrm (2000) - E3 2000 trailer | DC
snippet.description:
Draconus: Cult of the Wyrm (aka. Blades of Vengeance, Dragons Blood, Swords of Vengeance) is a action RPG game, released 2000 by Treyarch and Crave for Sega DreamCast.

Embark on an epic quest to unite the shattered kingdoms of humanity. Bring knowledge of the arcane arts and mastery of deadly swordplay to bear on the evil that jeopardizes these last bastions of civilization. The vile Dragon Lord has returned and in his shadow of impending doom an unholy pestilence threatens all mankind.
